tasks.title: Daily Life
tasks.instruction: Read some instructions related to starting a campus garden.

layout.body:
Build a Raised Garden Bed
Step 1: Prepare wooden boards for the size of bed you choose.
Step 2: Place the boards in a rectangle.
Step 3: Drill holes in the boards where they meet.
Step 4: Attach the boards with screws to form a frame.

questions.stem: Why would someone follow these instructions?

options.B: To make a wooden picture frame

questions.analysis: Why would someone follow these instructions? 原文依据：标题 Build a Raised Garden Bed，全文为搭建花园种植床的操作步骤。 翻译：搭建高架花园种植床，全部步骤围绕花园设施建造展开。 选项分析： (A) To build some bedroom furniture 制作卧室家具 → 错误，全文围绕花园建造，无家具相关内容 (B) To make a wooden picture frame 制作木质相框 → 错误，文中 frame 为花园床框架，并非相框 (C) To prepare a garden 筹备建造花园 → 正确，贴合标题与全文操作目的 (D) To paint some boards 给木板刷漆 → 错误，原文未提及任何喷漆、上色内容

questions.stem: In which step are the wooden boards connected?
questions.analysis: In which step are the wooden boards connected? 原文依据：Step 4: Attach the boards with screws to form a frame. 翻译：第四步：用螺丝固定木板，拼接组合成框架。 选项分析： (A) Step 1 第一步 → 错误，仅为准备木板材料 (B) Step 2 第二步 → 错误，只是摆放木板位置，未连接 (C) Step 3 第三步 → 错误，仅打孔，属于前置准备工序 (D) Step 4 第四步 → 正确，attach 表示连接、固定，是木板拼接的核心步骤
